snippet.title: CarX Drift Racing Online 2: Early Access Launch Announcement
snippet.description:
#carxtechnologies #carxdriftracingonline2 
CarX Drift Racing Online 2: Early Access Launch Announcement. 

The next chapter of Drift Racing Online series is almost here. 

On May 7, the game officially launches in Early Access on Steam!

Early Access is an opportunity to develop the game together with you. From this point on,We will continue to add new content and gradually improve the game’s mechanics based on your feedback.
This milestone was made possible by you - everyone who followed our development, took part in tests, and shared their ideas. Thank you for helping us create the game!

Add it to your Wishlist - the launch is just around the corner!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1826420/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online_2/

Stay tuned for the news!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/carx2/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/carx_tech/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/carx_technology
CarX Store: https://carx-store.com
